title: SecurityContext
description: Carries cryptographic signatures, audience binding, and provenance chains.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature or MAC of the payload.

signer_id.description: Identifier of the signing worker or orchestrator.

orchestrator_signature.description: Orchestrator signature over the entire task envelope.

identity_chain.description: Legacy path of IDs through which the message bubbled.

kid.description: Key identifier for STS token or asymmetric key rotation.
